**Definition 1.1** {#def-1 .definition tag=D301 env=definition}

A knot diagram is a projection of a knot to the plane with finitely many double points, each marked as an over crossing or an under crossing.

**Theorem 1.2** {#thm-1 .statement tag=T301 env=theorem}

Two diagrams show the same knot exactly when a finite sequence of the three Reidemeister moves takes one to the other.

**Theorem 1.3** Each knot has a diagram with an odd number of crossings or a diagram with no crossings.

The line above is a result that the text extractor did not mark.

**Lemma 1.4** {#lem-1 .remark tag=L301 env=remark}

A Reidemeister move of the first kind changes the number of crossings by one.

**Proof.** {#proof-1 .proof tag=P301}

This follows from [Definition 1.1](#def-1).
